title: Quadra | Enterprise Cloud & AI Solutions for Intelligent Business
description: Quadra, a global award-winning partner, architects the Intelligent Enterprise for the world's leading businesses. We transform complex Cloud & AI innovation into a competitive advantage, built on 25 years of deep, vendor-agnostic architectural expertise.

blocks.text: We help you migrate and modernize your databases on Google Cloud, moving from costly, restrictive legacy systems to scalable, open, and intelligent data platforms
Is Your Database a Performance Engine or a Pain Point?

Traditional, on-premise databases are often plagued by high license costs, performance bottlenecks, and significant management overhead. They can become the single biggest anchor holding back your application performance and agility.
A Blueprint for Database Freedom & Performance

We provide a strategic roadmap for your data. Our blueprint involves a thorough assessment of your workloads to determine the best path: migrating existing commercial databases to Google Cloud for better performance, or modernizing to Google's powerful, managed, cloud-native databases like Cloud SQL and Spanner to eliminate licensing and management burdens entirely.
Architecting the Full Spectrum of Your Modern Data Estate
We architect your transition from costly, restrictive legacy systems to scalable, open, and intelligent data platforms on Google Cloud

We migrate and manage your MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQL Server databases on Cloud SQL, eliminating the burden of patching and administration while delivering enterprise-grade high availability and performance.
